name: Taste of Changbai Northeastern Cuisine
reviews: This place is worth a visit! Food was impeccable! Love everything we ordered. The portions were huge and at reasonable prices! Their Sesame Cold Skin Noodles and Traditional Sweat & Sour Crispy pork is always my go to. Would absolutely come back again!

Decent food options, came for the crispy pork Guobao, chilli peanut chicken (ok so much better than I expected), cabbage vermicelli (pleasant surprised, slapped), was v yum, an excellent feed!! Alarm kept going off lmao with no means to fix it quickly?? (But who knows what’s going on, can’t assume  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯) fair rowdy atmosphere, food service, no limit on time which was appreciated.

What an absolute delightful find in Sydney Haymarket. We went in without much expectations and ordered what other tables ordered :)

Everything was delicious. Even the dishes with lots of veggies such as Chinese cabbage and eggplant are really good. The top dish is definitely the Northern-style deep fried pork with special sauce. Don’t miss the deep fried eggplant, sizzling pickled Chinese cabbage with pork and Clear noodles with peanut sauce (cold dish)

NorthEast Chinese Cuisine, Haymarket
Overall: 5/7
I really like their carbs! Their signature pork (Guo bao rou) definitely lives up to the hype, just a bit too vinegar-y for me. Things generally are only slightly spicy here.
This place is mega popular and aims for 2 seatings at 5pm and 7pm. So you basically need to be there and waiting by 4:45pm to ensure a table. They are strict with table seating times.
Don't expect good service here.

Guo Bao Rou, Sweet & Sour crispy pork: 5/7 - $29.8
Signature item #1. They make is so impressively crispy despite the copius amounts of sauce. Definitely the best GBR I've had in Sydney.
It is VERY vinegar-forward on the nose, but taste isn't too strong.

Cold skin noodles w PB: 5/7 - $18.8
Signature item #2. A really refreshing mix of noodles and sauce. Goes super well with all the heavy other dishes they have. Noodles are high quality and super bouncy, without being sticky.

Beef fried rice: 5/7 - $18.8
Really tasty! Rice is really well fried and there's a good balance of additions within.

Cumin lamb chops: 5/7 - $28.8

Iron Pot, Stir fried chkn: 4/7 - $29.8
Very tender chicken, but just wasn't the biggest fan of the sauce / flavour. Perhaps just a bit one-note?

Delicious food! Must try the traditional sweet n sour pork and the cold sesame noodles !

Value for money, and great location. I went around 12.30 on a weekday lunch, no line but have seen long queues at dinner time. I would recommend to come here in a group - portions are generous and the more people = more dishes you can order!

Will add this to my regular rotation of restaurants in the city.

It can be loud during busy times
